purpose: The Value card's write layer: its levels, Scale qualifiers and their option definitions, Meters and Meter lines, and the Scale record kept as lists, where one edit becomes the smallest writes (one changed item is one PATCH of its record, a new item one POST, a removed item one DELETE), with conflict handling, rollback and the migration of older stored lists, and every network call and cache supplied by the host.
namedChanges: Imports: `lib/base/planValue` and `lib/base/planValueModel` are `value-card-model`; `lib/base/planCard` (`rowServedFact`) is `plan-card-facts`; `lib/base/planLinks` (`recordTag`) is `plan-links-model`; `lib/base/planKinds` (`isResourceType`) is `plan-kinds`; `lib/base/planParts` (`asGrid`) is `description-parts-model` (compared with the source's: the same); `BaseRecord` and `GridRecord` are `base-record`. `applyPatch` is copied (see below).

`@tanstack/react-query` is gone. `ChildEnv.qc: QueryClient` is `ChildEnv.host: ValueWriteHost`. Every call outside the unit that is not a merged unit is a host member called with the same arguments, in the same place and order (the table in "What the host must supply"): `createRecord`, `readRecord`, `patchRecord`, the delete mutation (`useDeleteRecord`), `rememberRecord`, `markFreshlyCreated`, `loadPlanFind` through `fetchPlanFind`, `useQueries` through `usePlanFinds`, `qc.getQueryData(planFindKey(...))` through `cachedPlanFind`, `prependPlanFind`, `dropPlanFind`, `patchPlanFindRows`, `invalidatePlanFind`, `invalidatePlanSearch`, `liveRow`, `storePlanRow`, `ensureEtagUnchanged`, `reconcileAfterConflict`, `qc.setQueryData(planRecordKey(...))` through `setPlanRecord`, and `typeUriForVaultNamespace`.
`e instanceof RecordConflictError` and `e instanceof RecordForbiddenError` are `host.isConflict(e)` and `host.isForbidden(e)`. `httpStatus` (the duck-typed numeric `status`) is the source's.

`useQueryClient()` is `useValueWriteHost()` (reads `ValueWriteHostContext`, throws a sentence that names the provider when there is none); `useDeleteRecord(vaultId)` is `host.useDeleteRecord(vaultId)`. The `qc` entry of `useChildList`'s kept context is `host`.

In `useValueQualifiers.definitionRows` the lines `const key = planFindKey(...)` and the `qc.getQueryData(key)` / `qc.fetchQuery(...)` pair are `host.cachedPlanFind(...)` and `host.fetchPlanFind(..., { staleTime: 15_000 })`; the key is formed by the host.
Comments lose the names, batch tags, QA ids and round tags of the source; they keep their meaning. Nothing else in the six files is changed.

library.title: Value card write layer
library.note: Saves levels, qualifiers, meters and Scale as child records; a read-only Value card does not need it. Plan.Value
